verdict.rationale: Browserbase ships autonomous Agents for data gathering, created from natural-language goals and run on a schedule or on demand, so this axis applies. However, no evidence shows a configurable reasoning-effort setting (low/medium/high) for those agents. The documented Agent controls (pauseWhen, Optimize, system-prompt tuning) are adjacent features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can set how much reasoning effort an autonomous agent spends on a data-gathering task (low, medium, high)
